```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

data("instacart", package = "p8105.datasets")
```

Column {data-width=600}
-------------------------------------

### Purchases by department
```{r department_plot}
department_df = instacart |>
  count(department, name = "n_items")

department_plot = department_df |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = n_items,
    y = reorder(department, n_items)
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of items purchased",
    y = "Department"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(department_plot)
```

Column {data-width=400}
-------------------------------------

### Orders by hour of day

```{r hourly_plot}
hourly_df = instacart |>
  distinct(order_id, order_hour_of_day) |>
  count(order_hour_of_day, name = "n_orders")

hourly_plot = hourly_df |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = order_hour_of_day,
    y = n_orders
  )) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, by = 3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    x = "Hour of day (0–23)",
    y = "Number of orders"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(hourly_plot)
```

### Basket size by day of week

```{r basket_plot}
basket_df = instacart |>
  count(order_id, order_dow, name = "basket_size") |>
  mutate(order_dow = factor(order_dow, levels = 0:6))

basket_plot = basket_df |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = order_dow,
    y = basket_size
  )) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(
    x = "Day of week (dataset codes 0–6)",
    y = "Number of items per order"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(basket_plot)
```
